fusions.name: Broadside Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls a cannonball that deals 14 damage and knocks the target back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for every tile you have travelled, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Full Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 4 cannonballs in a wide spread, each dealing 10 damage and ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Bilge Pump
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Swell
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 15%. Your water resistance rises by 10%.
